results.title: Breaking News: 29 US States Seek $200 Billion Penalty As Company Faces Its Biggest Trial Yet
results.description: Meta is facing its biggest trial yet as a coalition of 29 US states accuses the company of deliberately designing Instagram and Facebook to make children addicted to social media.Four states — California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey — are representing the coalition, which first sued Meta in 2023. Prosecutors allege Meta “exploited how kids’ brains work” by keeping young users engaged, harvesting their data and concealing the risks.The states are seeking up to $200 billion in penalties, in a case being described by some experts as social media’s “big tobacco moment”.
